title: 《荀子·正名》
provenance_note: All classifications, forms and readings are AI reconstruction (Claude); commentary readings marked 记忆 are from memory and unverified (待核).

wu_units_戊.note: 文本以贵贱之等为制名所以然之一：二分与等级；分别在此不是佛典之妄念义
复述 XZ-030；丁为第二功能
君与民之知不对称：等级
心对欲之制：不对称之等；也可读为一人之内的两个关系（定域）

ji_note: No unit rejects a thesis of the plan explicitly.

most_important.why: 化 := 状变而实无别而为异: different under the class of shape, not distinct under the class of 实 (§一)
一实 := 有化而无别: the criterion is 实无别, not 同所; strains §一 '一实以所计'
二实 := 状同而为异所: 所 is used to count two, not stated as the criterion of one
状 and 所 cross: two classes that can disagree (乙 proposal, low)
稽实定数: counting 实 belongs to 制名; carrier equality as a commitment of naming (§二)
宜 := 约定俗成: a name's fitness is conventional
实名 by convention: which 实 a name fixes is agreed, not given
缘天官: the ground of 同异 is the sense relation; the plan excludes this sense of 缘 (§4.1) but its 验/类 grounding (§4.4) has the same structure
同类同情者，其天官之意物也同: a reading depends on the class of the reader (丙一)
征知 requires the 天官 first to register the kind: the heart's knowing composes with the sense relation (丙一, necessary condition)
物，大共名: the coarsest name, like the class 一
推而共之…至于无共然后止: iterated coarsening to the top; the top exists analytically, termination needs finiteness
推而别之…至于无别然后至: iterated refinement; the finest class (静) exists, reaching it by steps needs finiteness
异实异名、同实同名: holds only at one level of naming (共名/别名), i.e. relative to a class; contrasts 墨经 重同 二名一实
戊: 制名 is to 明贵贱 as well as 辨同异: the text sets rank as a purpose of names; 分别 here means distinguishing, not 妄念
名 := 所以期累实
名之丽 := 累而成文: names compose into 文 (§三 成文)
辨说 := 不异实名以喻动静之道: a name's reference must stay fixed through an argument
有欲无欲 belongs to the class 生死, not 治乱: a distinction has sense relative to one class (定域)
事 := 正利而为: 事 is purposive action, not the plan's 事 (a related position)
亡于情之所欲: 亡 = 无 (does not lie in), another sense of 亡
性 := 生之所以然者 (and a second 性 at XZ-ZM-003): 生 = life / what is produced
Chain 性 := 天之就, 情 := 性之质, 欲 := 情之应 (XZ-ZM-140–142): definitions by relation
衡不正 → 读数误: a reading is relative to its standard (丙一)
王者起 → 循于旧名 ∧ 作于新名: names themselves continue and arise

缘: XZ-ZM-027/032/046/071 所缘 = the ground by which
化: XZ-ZM-063 change of shape with the 实 unchanged
亡: XZ-ZM-138/139 = 无, not lie in; never 'end' in this chapter
尽: XZ-ZM-094 尽故 exhaust the reasons
XZ-ZM-146/147/149 fully satisfy, approach the full (近尽)
理: XZ-ZM-091 经理 = pattern of order
XZ-ZM-103 长少之理 = order of rank
分别: XZ-ZM-030 to distinguish (neutral, positive), unlike the Buddhist 妄念 sense that motivated the plan's renaming
性/伪/知/能: each defined twice (XZ-ZM-002/003, 006/007, 010/011, 012/013): a capacity and its realized fit (所以X之在人者 / X有所合)

strains_with_plan.plan: §一 '一实以“所”（处所）计' and §5.2 一实
strains_with_plan.point: The text uses 异所 to count two (二实) but defines 一实 by 化而无别 (实无别), and says 异状而同所者 '可别也'. It never states 同所 ⇒ 一实; 实 is presupposed, not counted by 所. The plan's 'in the class of place, continuation' reads more than the text states.
荀子 化 is change of shape with the 实 undistinguished (or moral transformation); narrower than the plan's 化 = 进.

The excluded sense (ground of 同异 in the sense relation) is the structure the plan uses for grounding a class in 'a relation one has 缘 with' (§4.3 item 4, §4.4 验). Excluding the word is fine; the structure is an ally, and 验之所缘以同异 (XZ-ZM-071, verified) is close to §4.4.
戊: rank (贵贱) as a purpose of naming; 君/民 asymmetry of knowing; 心 regulating 欲 from 天. Register as 相分.

strains_with_plan.plan: §4.3 四相 (亡 = end of a 续)
strains_with_plan.point: 亡 in this chapter means 无 (absent), not ceasing.
事 is defined as purposive action (正利而为); the plan's 事 as a relationally located position should be marked as a term of art.
